# Write: Zeisel mouse brain

## Create the report

```bash
Rscript scripts/R/create_report.R zeisel
```

Open `reports/zeisel-report.qmd`. The helper preserves an existing report. See [Write the report](../../02-write-the-report.qmd) for the shared reporting structure.

## Describe the study and the subset separately

Name Zeisel et al. (2015), link the [original paper](https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aaa1934), and state that the script retrieved counts through `scRNAseq::ZeiselBrainData()`. Record the source package version and exported dimensions from your own provenance file.

Explain that the analysis uses the first 400 cells in source order, rather than a random sample or the full published dataset. Report that donor/sample mapping was not validated. Published labels are retained as context, not generated by this analysis.

## Build a checked result paragraph

For the verified run, a starting point is:

> The exported matrix contained 20,006 genes and 400 cells. All 400 passed the illustrative QC cutoffs. Cell 1772071015_C02 had 22,354 counts, 4,871 detected genes and a mitochondrial fraction of 3.462468%, confirmed by independent recalculation. Tshz1's transformed value was 0.8510231. PCA showed expression structure within the convenience subset; this analysis did not establish cell identities or a condition effect.

Add the actual cutoff values, transformation, selected-gene count and variance percentages. Include the QC and PCA figures already linked in the starter. Every numeric claim should be traceable to a table or calculation.

## State limits and a useful follow-up

Do not translate “all passed QC” into a universal quality claim. Do not estimate tissue proportions or infer donor-level differences from this subset. A justified follow-up is to validate donor/tissue/batch mapping, inspect quality-related variation and design a fuller annotation or sample-level analysis before testing biological hypotheses.

Record what AI helped with and how its suggestions were checked. AI may help organize your explanation, but it cannot supply missing sample metadata.

## Render and review

```bash
cd reports
quarto render zeisel-report.qmd
cd ..
```

Check `reports/zeisel-report.html` for both figures, accurate values and a visible subset limitation. Remove bracketed starter text. Keep the report in ignored `reports/`.

**Your task:** locate the evidence for each sentence in your result paragraph. When you can defend it, continue with [Define: Your own study](../your-study/00-define.qmd).
